claim_boundary.optimizer_state_result: The terminal dense Muon state admits an answer-conditioned bilateral plus low-rank decomposition.
claim_boundary.weight_manifold_result: The corresponding tested fixed dictionaries do not align with useful c_fc weight motion above near-ambient recovery.
claim_boundary.forbidden_inference: Low-rank residual structure in dense optimizer state does not by itself authorize a learned low-rank weight basis or a compact Mapping Network decoder.

evidence.finding: Answer-conditioned input-then-output bilateral plus additive normals reaches the permissive state gates at 54.1314% of joint dense state bytes; momentum needs 493 total residual ranks and feedback needs one rank.
The answer-conditioned bilateral fixed-singular orbit explains 99.90% of c_fc displacement energy and 95.45% to nearly 100% of held-out CE value; radial motion is negligible.
Fixed random FHT-conjugated general charts at 135168 coordinates per layer capture only about 5.5-5.7% of dense Muon motion and lose to fresh88 on every held-out CE window.
The natural-axis chart captures 6.03% of motion at a 5.34% coordinate fraction, only about 1.13 times ambient.
Task-matched sparse bilateral joint charts fail held-out CE despite same-budget controls, establishing basis/connectivity mismatch rather than a coefficient-solver defect.

accounting.reason: The procedural c_fc path retains a materialized dense weight and dense custom temporal optimizer state outside ordinary model.parameters().
accounting.reason_learned_basis_rejected: It would be a LoRA-like learned-basis escape and would not test the fixed compact decoder claimed by Mapping Networks.

decision.accepted_compact_endpoint: 124M/20TPP QK-only attention with dense V, dense attention c_proj, and dense MLP
decision.next_action: Return to the full-attention gap and require a zero-update layer/phase attribution for generated V and attention c_proj before any successor training arm.
